summary: The StudentPrerequisites class manages medical and safety information required for students, including fields for COVID-19, influenza, hepatitis, and more. It supports operations like updating and validating prerequisite records.
purpose: To maintain prerequisite health and safety records for students involved in HSPnet programs.

workflows.name: Update Student Health Data
steps: Gather updated health data for student.
Validate data, ensuring all required fields are filled.
Commit updates to database using appropriate procedures.
